definitions.gloss: to maintain; to keep; to preserve
definitions.explanation: To keep something in a certain state or condition over time. Used for maintaining health, relationships, appearances, or standards.

examples.japanese: {良|よ}い{姿勢|しせい}を{保|たも}ちたい。
examples.english: I want to maintain good posture.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}を{保|たも}つために{運動|うんどう}する。
examples.english: I exercise to maintain my health.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}).

ASPECT: {保|たも}っている indicates ongoing maintenance of a state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xを{保|たも}つ (to maintain X)
・{健康|けんこう}を{保|たも}つ (to maintain health)
・{品質|ひんしつ}を{保|たも}つ (to maintain quality)
・{関係|かんけい}を{保|たも}つ (to maintain a relationship)
・{距離|きょり}を{保|たも}つ (to keep distance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{維持|いじ}する (to maintain - more formal)
・{守|まも}る (to protect/keep)
